title: Dalia
_note: PRO_03, A1.3. Lines keep MAIN_QUEST.md IDs where they have one, for voicing. Options show short text; spoken is the fuller line he says. starts: the first whose condition holds opens the conversation.

afterMarket.speaker: Dalia
afterMarket.text: You shouldn't have looked at him like that. He remembers faces. That's the only thing he's good at. [Quieter.] Thank you.

choices.text: Let me see what you have.

a13.speaker: Dalia
a13.text: You want Tarik. Everybody can see it on you. He rides the east road every morning with two riders and a boy they pressed into service last month. Past the crossroads, past the Haddad place. He stops to drink where nobody can see.

boy.speaker: Dalia
boy.text: Fifteen, sixteen. Holds a spear like a broom. He's not one of them. Not yet.

tarikDone.speaker: Dalia
tarikDone.text: The tax is suspended for a week. Nobody knows who to pay. [She taps a ledger of her own.] I've been keeping my own numbers for years. What he took, what he said he took. If anyone ever asks.

idle.speaker: Dalia
idle.text: Salt, oil, cloth. Bandages, since everyone seems to need them lately.

choices.text: Let me see what you have.
